text: This solution, Environment Canterbury Climate Resilience Programme (COVID‑19 shovel‑ready projects) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in New Zealand between Environment Canterbury (ECan), Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment (MBIE), Kānoa – Regional Economic Development & Investment Unit, and Local contractors and specialist firms. The program was implemented in 2020 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
